gear:_resolve_row_by_lot_slot.text:
func _resolve_row_by_lot_slot(lot_slot: int) -> int:
	"""The live row recorded against `lot_slot` at ANY generation, or NULL_ROW.

	Used only to keep one lot slot from carrying two gear records; every public path compares
	the full reference.
	"""
	if lot_slot < 0 or lot_slot >= LOT_CAPACITY:
		return NULL_ROW
	var row: int = _lot_row[lot_slot]
	if row < 0 or row >= _row_capacity or _occupied[row] != 1 or _lot_slot[row] != lot_slot:
		return NULL_ROW
	return row

haul_carry:_owns_live_satchel.text:
func _owns_live_satchel(hauler_slot: int, satchel: Vector2i) -> bool:
	"""Whether `satchel` is a live satchel row owned by this present resident."""
	return satchel != NULL_REF and _inventory.is_satchel(satchel) \
		and _inventory.container_owner(satchel) == _residents.ref_of(hauler_slot)
